args.query:
WITH rev AS (
  SELECT SUM(o.amount) AS revenue_eur
  FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_kcmax.orders` o
  JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_kcmax.customers` c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_date = DATE '2026-10-01' AND c.country = 'DE'
),
ret AS (
  SELECT SUM(r.amount) AS returns_eur
  FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_kcmax.returns` r
  JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_kcmax.customers` c ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE r.return_date = DATE '2026-10-01' AND c.country = 'DE'
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(rev.revenue_eur, 0) AS revenue_eur,
  COALESCE(ret.returns_eur, 0) AS returns_eur,
  COALESCE(rev.revenue_eur, 0) - COALESCE(ret.returns_eur, 0) AS net_revenue_eur
FROM rev CROSS JOIN ret
